H1: Freezing the in-transit anchor (committed_next / committed_arrive / committed_finish and the current physical state), at least one of the R14 reveal phases admits >=2 DISTINCT candidate plans for the not-yet-executed suffix that pass the same route-level reference check, AND those candidates are distinguishable by the first action AFTER the anchor.
anchor_freeze_assertions: the committed_next order is NOT in any candidate suffix
all accepted-unserved orders still appear exactly once across the fleet
corrected_premise: DOMAIN-01 attributed the not-yet-executed suffix of an in-transit vehicle to the commitment contract. That attribution is NOT established: P2-POS-01 declares it as a conservative action domain ("not a general optimum domain"), and build_vehicle_plans() already represents a committed vehicle as anchor=(committed_next, committed_finish, load after pickup) with the remaining route as its suffix. This package tests whether the suffix is legally reconstructable while the anchor stays frozen.
data: the 289 saved public phases of OPP-01/CTRL-01; no new root day
mask_scope_under_test: size-2 masks over the queue (P2-POS-01 keeps the fixed pair rule); size-1 enumerated for context only
parent: P2-C-DOMAIN-01 (which measured that the lock is the single in-transit vehicle)
primary_control: the current conservative action domain: identical enumeration and identical reference check, but the in-transit vehicle left out of allowed_vehicle_ids

primary_metrics.n_anchor_candidates: distinct plan_hash values over the full fleet, anchor frozen
primary_metrics.n_next_action_after_anchor: number of distinct first elements of the in-transit vehicle suffix after the anchor; 0 = depot return

reference_check: route_check (customer TW + capacity + depot return) via the shared certify/enumerate path; energy and quality are NOT checked because the C0 budget B is AWAITING_USER_BUDGET_RULING
synthetic_test: a hand-built minimal instance (NOT a source day) driven by the real unmodified StrictOnlineEnv, to check that a suffix installed behind a frozen anchor is actually consumed in order and is not silently dropped at a reveal or a service completion; plan-storage/persistence consistency is a STOP CONDITION
